| 7 — MEDIUM | Process ORD-009, ORD-025, ORD-021 (pending orders, high priority customers waiting) | OMS |

**Bottom line:** The supply chain is showing systemic delays across all four systems. The root bottleneck is PROD-001 stock — 8 units in the warehouse, 67 units of active demand, and the replenishment PO is itself overdue. The refrigeration failure on SHP-009 is an independent risk that needs immediate resolution before product is lost. SUP-003 (Prachuap Harvest) should be flagged for performance review given rating 2.8 and two consecutive late POs.
